# Framework comparison

<!-- Generated by bin/generate-framework-matrix from the packages themselves; do not edit by hand. -->

Lily has one catalog of 661 components (473 core and 188 national identifiers) and
a headless library for each of ten frameworks. Every library follows the same contract: the same component names, the
same kebab-case class hook on each root element, the same ARIA and keyboard behaviour, and no CSS. What differs is the
framework's own idiom (props and events, slots, bindings) and how much of the catalog a framework can express.

| Framework      | Headless package                                   | Supports                       | Core components | National identifiers | Unit tested | Storybook stories | Helper packages | Example app | Skill | Tutorial |

- **Headless package** is the package to install; the national identifiers are its add-on, the same name with
  `-identifiers` (`LilyDesignSystem.Blazor.Headless.Identifiers` for Blazor). Versions are the repository's, which
  are the published ones once released.
- **Supports** is the package's `peerDependencies` (Blazor: its target framework).
- **Core components** and **National identifiers** count the components with an implementation file. Web Components
  leaves out the table parts and interactive list items, which an autonomous custom element cannot stand in for.
- **Unit tested** and **Storybook stories** count the components with a test or a story file. Solid and Blazor have
  no Storybook (no Storybook framework supports Solid 2; Blazor uses bUnit).
- **Helper packages** are the opinionated packages beside each library (pickers, data grid, calendar and the rest),
  from `bin/list-helper-packages`.

Choosing: use the library for the framework your app is already written in; they are equivalent by design. With no
framework, use HTML (copy the markup) or Web Components (import once, use the tags). To start:
[Getting started in five minutes](https://lilydesignsystem.com/getting-started/). For how Lily compares with other
design systems, see [COMPARE.md](../COMPARE.md).
